title: PixieCore Blueprint v1
description: A single, typed, independently testable cognitive operation executed by PixieCore.

name.description: Human-readable name of this one cognitive operation.

version.description: Blueprint version in major.minor or major.minor.patch numeric form.

role.description: Registered agent role used to prepare provider messages. Custom plugins may add role names.

prompt.description: Instructions for exactly one cognitive operation. Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then Gherkin form is recommended but not required. Portable named inputs use Mustache-style {{ name }} syntax; single braces remain a PixieCore 0.x compatibility syntax.

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema applied to normalized business inputs before provider execution. A string must contain a JSON-encoded schema.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema used for structured provider output and runtime output validation. A string must contain a JSON-encoded schema.

input_placeholders.description: Named inputs accepted by the Blueprint. A legacy string means a required string input.

localization.description: String-valued language, locale, currency, timezone, or date-format settings available to the prompt.

permissions.description: Role, user, and scope allow or deny lists evaluated before provider execution.

examples.description: Few-shot input and output examples inserted before the live request.

model.description: Optional provider model override for this Blueprint.

tools.description: Names of registered tools available to this Blueprint.

placeholderName.description: A flat input binding name. ASCII identifiers are portable; dots and hyphens are PixieCore compatibility extensions.

name.description: Placeholder name used in the prompt.

required.description: Whether the caller must supply this input. Defaults to false for typed declarations.

default.description: Value used when an optional input is omitted.
